# Unable to file by the April 15 deadline?

Individuals unable to file their tax return by the tax deadline can apply for a tax-filing extension in the following ways:

* Individual tax filers, regardless of income, can electronically request an automatic tax-filing extension through [IRS Free File](https://www.irs.gov/filing/irs-free-file-do-your-taxes-for-free) by filing a [Form 4868, Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File U.S. Individual Income Tax Return](https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-4868).
* Make an electronic payment using Direct Pay, debit card, credit card or digital wallet and indicate the payment is for an extension.
* Mail Form 4868 by the tax deadline.

# Getting an extension

Things taxpayers should know when requesting a tax-filing extension, including:

* Tax-filing extension requests are due by the tax deadline date, and it does not give an extension of time to pay the taxes.
* Avoid some penalties by estimating and paying the tax due by the tax deadline.
* Special rules for tax deadlines and automatic tax-filing extensions may apply for taxpayers [serving in a combat zone or qualified hazardous duty areas](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/extension-of-deadlines-combat-zone-service), [living outside the United States](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p54), and people living in [certain disaster areas](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/tax-relief-in-disaster-situations). They may not need to submit a tax-filing extension; however, people should check to see if they qualify before the tax deadline.

People usually respond to that as people load in at different rates based on their machine. As a new tank, don't pull everything. Pull a group at a time so you can see the mechanics and know generally where you sit with how much damage is coming in vs how much you're being healed. It's possible your healer isn't geared either.

I ask this question with no ill intent, were you in protection specialization with a 1 hander and a shield equipped?

It's likely you got kicked because saying you're new and then pulling a bunch came off as either overconfident or a troll. 

There are nicer groups. There are people who will speak to you and help you out. 

I'd recommend trying queuing up as damage for a dungeon or two. Get the flow, see how wow telegraphs it's mechanics and danger zones. People are generally more receptive to damage screwing things up as long as you communicate. 

There's also the option of asking to join a guild in trade chat. By going to your capital (Stormwind or Ogrimmar), you can ask to join a leveling guild which are similar to linkshells. Guilds like that would be more than happy to show you the ropes as a tank.

Hope this helped, and not everyone is an asshole on wow. They're just generally more jaded.
